methodology: Rankings are compiled from the September 2026 public record: TikTok Shop US and UK weekly product charts as republished by EchoTik, FastMoss and cross-border trade press, Amazon US best-seller rank and search-velocity reporting, Temu best-seller roundups plus Temu's own Q2 GMV disclosure, and AliExpress order-velocity leaderboards. Unit and revenue figures are the most recent published values, not live API pulls. Platform percentages are year-on-year where published and quarter-on-quarter or month-on-month where that is all that was reported; Amazon, Shein, AliExpress and TikTok Shop UK/EU move on quarterly disclosure cycles and may lag the reporting month. Where a platform published nothing new this month, the previous edition's figure is carried forward and flagged on the card rather than replaced with a guess. Category shares, retail price bands and every sourcing range are OZ estimates derived from those same public reports and are marked as such.

platforms.name: TikTok Shop
platforms.note: Q3 GMV up 62% year on year, though the quarter-on-quarter rate eased about 15 points. Beauty still the base, but home supplies climbed from 11th to 6th category.

platforms.name: Amazon
platforms.note: US site GMV up 8.2% year on year in Q3. Kitchen storage and small appliances carried September; FBA peak surcharges are squeezing thin listings.

platforms.name: Temu
platforms.note: Q2 GMV growth fell below 10% for the first time, with several EU markets down more than 30%. Semi-managed and overseas warehouse are now the price of entry.

platforms.name: AliExpress
platforms.note: Order-velocity leaderboard after the 9.9 Super Deals window. No new growth disclosure this month, so the previous figure is carried forward.

platforms.name: Shein
platforms.note: First interim report since the Hong Kong listing: H1 net revenue up 1%, orders up 6.4%, adjusted profit down 55.6%. Home is expanding off a small base.

platforms.name: TikTok Shop
platforms.note: The UK chart reads like a home-goods chart — walking pads, blenders, cordless vacuums. No fresh September disclosure, so the previous figure is carried forward.

items.name: Die-cast Alloy Car Model (1:64)
items.note: Held the top of the US weekly product chart in three of the four September weeks. Shantou and Chenghai own this supply chain outright; alloy ratio, paint lead content and ASTM F963 / EN71 age labelling are the three things that fail at inspection.

items.name: Cordless Pressure Washer
items.note: The only non-beauty product to hold a US top-ten slot across September. Battery cell grade and IPX5 water-ingress testing decide whether it survives a second summer — ask who supplies the cells, not just the amp-hour rating.

items.name: Air Fryer Parchment Liners (125 ct)
items.note: A consumable, not an appliance — 4.6 stars and repeat purchase built into the SKU. Food-grade paper certification and heat resistance to 230°C are the two specs that separate a relistable product from a recall.

items.name: Halloween Bat Projector Lamp
items.note: Listed under camping lighting rather than Halloween decor, so one SKU harvested two demand curves at once. Purely seasonal: October is the last buying window, and the LED driver needs CE / UKCA paperwork before it ships to Europe.

items.name: Stainless Steel Cutting Board
items.note: The fastest-growing kitchen search term of the month, sold as a direct replacement for plastic boards. Get the 304 versus 430 steel grade in writing — the 430 versions rust, and rust is what shows up in one-star reviews.

items.name: Portable Power Station (300W class)
items.note: Highest ticket on this list and a US top-ten fixture through September. UN38.3 transport testing and cell certification are non-negotiable for sea freight — budget eight weeks for the paperwork, not two.

items.name: Freestanding Kitchen Paper Towel Holder
items.note: Part of the September kitchen-storage wave on Amazon US. No-drill and freestanding is the entire pitch, so base weight and the anti-slip foot are what buyers complain about — check both on a physical sample.

items.name: Acrylic DIY Fridge Magnet Set
items.note: A two-cent acrylic blank sold as personalised home decor, which is where all the margin sits. Ask for the UV print adhesion test result — cheap prints peel, and peeling prints get refunded.

items.name: Weighted Pressure Blanket
items.note: New into the US top ten in late September on stress-relief positioning. Glass bead fill has to be evenly quilted or it migrates into one corner after two washes — that single defect drives most of the returns in this category.

items.name: Foldable Walking Pad Treadmill
items.note: The UK chart is a home-goods chart, not a beauty chart. UKCA marking and a UK plug are the obvious items; the motor duty-cycle rating is the one buyers forget to ask for and the one that fails first.

items.name: Rechargeable Hair & Beard Clipper
items.note: A long-running AliExpress order-velocity leader rather than a new spike, which makes it a safer first container. Blade steel and battery cycle count hold the rating up; a genuine charger certification is what clears customs.

items.name: Raised Garden Planter with Legs
items.note: Temu's September story is durability, not velocity: Q2 growth fell below 10% for the first time and several EU markets dropped more than 30%. Freight is the margin killer here — volume per container matters more than unit cost.
